Island Geography & Heritage

Iconic Sri Lankan Destinations

From the arid ancient citadels of the Cultural Triangle to the cool misty high-country tea estates and the golden palm-fringed southern shores.

Cultural Triangle

Cultural Triangle
2 - 3 Days

Sigiriya & The Cultural Triangle

The Ancient 5th-Century Sky Fortress & Royal Water Gardens

Rising 200 meters above emerald jungle canopies, Sigiriya (Lion Rock) is Sri Lanka's most celebrated UNESCO World Heritage wonder. An architectural masterpiece of King Kashyapa with preserved frescoes, mirror walls, and summit palace ruins.

Read Destination Guide
Cultural Triangle
1 Day

Polonnaruwa

The Medieval Royal Kingdom & Colossal Rock-Carved Buddhas

The splendid second capital of ancient Ceylon (11th–13th century), renowned for the monumental Gal Vihara granite rock sculptures and the colossal sea of Parakrama Samudra reservoir.

Read Destination Guide

Central Highlands

Central Highlands
2 Days

Kandy (Maha Nuwara)

The Sacred Hill Capital & Guardian of the Sacred Tooth Relic

Nestled amidst misty green hill amphitheaters and circled by the Mahaweli River, Kandy is the spiritual heart of the island and the last royal kingdom of Ceylon before British rule.

Read Destination Guide
Central Highlands
2 - 3 Days

Nuwara Eliya

The 'Little England' of Ceylon & Grand Tea Country

Perched at 1,868 meters elevation, Nuwara Eliya offers crisp mountain breezes, colonial Tudor-style country houses, rolling emerald tea carpet hills, and picturesque waterfalls.

Read Destination Guide
Central Highlands
1 - 2 Days

Haputale & Lipton's Seat

High-Altitude Cloud Forests & Sir Thomas Lipton's Heritage

Perched on a dramatic southern ridge overlooking endless coastal plains, Haputale is the quieter, atmospheric hill station famed for Sir Thomas Lipton's tea empire and panoramic mountain drops.

Read Destination Guide
Central Highlands
2 - 3 Days

Ella

The Nine Arch Bridge, Mountain Gap & Laid-Back High Country

Ella is a mountain paradise blessed with dramatic topography, cascading ravines, the world-famous colonial Nine Arch viaduct, and invigorating hikes suitable for all ages.

Read Destination Guide

South Coast

South Coast
2 - 4 Days

Mirissa & The South Coast

Crescent Golden Bays, Blue Whales & Coconut Tree Hill

Mirissa is the jewel of the southern shoreline, famed worldwide for ethical blue whale ocean safaris, curved sandy bays, iconic coconut palm headlands, and fresh seafood by lantern light.

Read Destination Guide
South Coast
1 - 2 Days

Galle Fort

UNESCO 17th-Century Living Dutch Citadel by the Ocean

A living UNESCO heritage fortress where Portuguese, Dutch, and British colonial ramparts enclose cobbled lanes, artisan boutique stores, jeweler workshops, and ocean-facing bastions.

Read Destination Guide
South Coast
1 - 2 Days

Hikkaduwa

Reef Coast, Sea Turtles & Our Southern Home Base

A lively Indian Ocean town and home base for Manju Tours Lanka, known for its beach, coral reef, sea turtles, and easy access to Galle Fort.

Read Destination Guide

Southern Wilderness

Southern Wilderness
1 - 2 Days

Yala National Park

The Realm of the Sri Lankan Leopard & Wild Asian Elephants

Sri Lanka's premier wildlife park, boasting one of the world's highest densities of wild leopards (Panthera pardus kotiya), wandering sloth bears, and huge elephant herds.

Read Destination Guide

East Coast

East Coast
2 - 3 Days

Trincomalee & Nilaveli

Turquoise Coral Lagoons, Pigeon Island & Ancient Koneswaram

Famed for one of the world's greatest natural deep-water harbors, powdery white sands at Nilaveli, and the cliffside Hindu temple of Koneswaram perched high above Swami Rock.

Read Destination Guide
